notes: U1 ref narrowed to the shirt the mask covers; U2 owner disambiguated and replacement made structural; U3 roof removal (ill-posed) retargeted to removing the pink flag with a SAM3 mask; U4 object is a rice-straw bundle, not a broom.

spec.ref: the purple shirt of the central performer

units.ref_zh: 中央表演者的紫色上衣
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将中央表演者的紫色上衣的颜色改为深蓝色。
units.reason: Mask covers only the purple shirt (around the bamboo angklung); the matching trousers are not masked, so the ref now names the shirt.

spec.ref: the black shirt of the man in a black headband just right of the central performer

units.ref_zh: 中央表演者右侧紧邻的戴黑头带男子的黑色上衣
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将中央表演者右侧紧邻的戴黑头带男子的黑色上衣替换为一件白色无袖背心。
units.reason: 'a white costume' was a recolour; a sleeveless vest is a structural change. Many people stand behind the performer; the masked shirt belongs to the man in the black headband directly to his right.

spec.ref: the pink flag above the central performer

units.ref_zh: 中央表演者上方的粉色旗帜
units.instruction_ref_zh: 移除中央表演者上方的粉色旗帜。
units.reason: Removing a hut's thatched roof is a large-structure removal with undefined result. Retargeted (remove kept) to the pink flag (SAM3 'pink flag', x1122-1288,y0-463, verified, no overlap with U1).

spec.ref: the bundle of rice straw beside the central performer

units.ref_zh: 中央表演者旁的稻草捆
units.instruction_ref_zh: 在中央表演者旁的稻草捆上加上一条蓝色丝带。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 给选中区域加上一条蓝色丝带。
units.reason: Object is a tied sheaf of rice straw hanging from a carrying pole, not a broom.
